svg.aria-label: A DABstep task enters one Claude Agent SDK session on Haiku 4.5 with a single execute_python tool; the tool runs pandas in a persistent namespace with the version's helper module loaded per task; the session returns a one-line JSON answer that the benchmark's vendored scorer grades against gold.

g.title: task — one of the ten dev tasks with gold, or one of the 450 without; question text plus the guidelines for the answer format
the agent — one Claude Agent SDK session per task on claude-haiku-4-5, system prompt from agents/vN/system.md, agent.yaml frozen at 20 turns and 270 s; the only tool is execute_python
helper.py — the version's helper module, loaded from file per task so champion and challenger never share one; 57 lines in v0, 325 in v1, 440 in v2
execute_python — an in-process MCP server: persistent namespace, pandas preloaded, 120 s per call, output over 12k chars truncated, the same code three times returns STOP
the scorer — question_scorer vendored verbatim from the DABstep space and excluded from lint; exact match on numbers, strings and lists
the answer — one line of JSON, agent_answer formatted to the task's guidelines, written to results.jsonl with its cost, turns and duration

svg.text: scored by the benchmark's own scorer
